## InvoiceRouter Odoo Production v2.1.1

Account-count agnostic production workflow. Every enabled provider row is loaded. Includes durable retry/failover, original-row provider preflight writeback, capability-driven Odoo version handling, provider-side-effect lease verification, and safe pre-provider lease recovery.
